run_PrintLogReader_all_hooks: run the PrintLogReader on a Cuberite log directory to print all server hook events to stdout
run_PrintLogReader_only_hooks: run the PrintLogReader with --only flags to print only specific hook events like CHAT or KILLED
run_PrintLogReader_ignore_hooks: run the PrintLogReader with --ignore flags to print all hook events except specified ones
review_PrintLogReader_class: review the PrintLogReader class that dynamically creates on_hookname methods for each registered hook in util.HOOK_MAP
review_PrintLogReader_init: review the PrintLogReader constructor that accepts ignore_hooks or only_hooks but not both simultaneously
